messages.充電回数6を消耗するS2「充電跳躍」で自分と味方2名に充電力場を配り、充電編成全: A W Corp. buffer that spends 6 Charge Count on S2 Charged Leap to grant Charge Barrier to herself and 2 allies, improving the whole Charge team's Shield and Charge supply. Slow to start and better suited to longer fights.
messages.S2「充電跳躍」: 使用時に自分の充電回数を6消耗してコイン威力+1(低い同期化: **S2 — Charged Leap**: On use, spends 6 of her Charge Count for +1 Coin Power (+1 Base Power at lower Uptie). If spent, gives (Charge + 2) Charge Barrier to herself and the 2 allies with the least Charge Count (up to 8, up to 2 times per turn; Charge + 1, up to 7, once at lower Uptie). Coin Ⅱ inflicts 1 Bind next turn on hit, plus 2 more if Charge was spent.
messages.充電力場: 値×3のバリアを得る(W社職員なら×5)。そのバリアを失うと1減り、: **Charge Barrier**: Grants Shield of value×3 (×5 for W Corp. employees). It decreases by 1 when that Shield is lost, and at Turn End the bearer gains Charge Count equal to its value, after which the Charge Barrier and Shield disappear.
messages.充電回数の獲得: S1「波動」は使用時に+2、Ⅱコインで+2。S2は使用時に+2: **Gaining Charge Count**: S1 Ripple adds +2 on use and +2 with Coin Ⅱ. S2 adds +2 on use and +2 each with Coins Ⅰ and Ⅱ (+1 each at lower Uptie). The Defense skill Deploy Plasma adds +2 on use (up to 3 times per turn, 2 at lower Uptie). S1 gains +1 Base Power at 4 or more Charge Count and +1 Clash Power per 5 Charge Count (up to 2).
messages.S3「次元切断」: Ⅳコインの的中時、(5-充電)だけ自分の充電回数が増える。充: **S3 — Rip Dimension**: On Coin Ⅳ hit, her Charge Count increases by (5 − Charge). Spending 15 Charge Count (or all of it, if she has 2 or more Charge and 7–14 Charge Count) grants +2 Coin Power (+1 at lower Uptie). At Combat Start, it gives Load (more damage for attack skills that spent Charge Count, doubled for W Corp. employees) to herself and allies with Charge (up to the highest Resonance).
messages.バトルパッシブ「過充電/整理指示」(嫉妬×3・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 戦闘中に: **Combat passive — Overcharge / Cleanup Order (3 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains 1 Charge Potency each time she spends a cumulative 10 Charge Count during battle. At Turn End, gives 1 Clash Power Up next turn to (Charge value) W Corp. employees including herself, starting from the back of team order (up to 5).
messages.S1・守備で充電回数を貯め、6以上になったらS2で消耗して、自分と味方2名に充電: Build Charge Count with S1 and her Defense skill, and once it reaches 6 or more, spend it with S2 to hand out Charge Barrier to herself and 2 allies. Repeating this lets Charge allies endure with Shield while replenishing Charge Count, with larger Shield for W Corp. employees. Early on, before she has Charge, she can also fire S3 to gain Charge Count (there is little point in saving it). Without Gifts or ally support, she cannot use S2's spending effect on turn 2, so she starts slowly. The longer the fight, the more Charge Potency and the passive's Clash Power Up grow.
